reference._note: What the research expects (Nov 2025 - Nov 2026 replay on today's terms). The paper test checks whether this still holds.
reference._planc_note: Plan C with the 2:2:1 rule: a fresh Rs 5 lakh in Jan-Nov 2026 with the last-12-months order -> +53%; about 5 trades a month; compounding from Jan 2022 about 61.5% a year (Rs 5 lakh -> Rs 51.9 lakh). The % is lower as the pot grows: each stock only takes so much money at the open. These use the final auction prices to choose stocks; the live bot must choose at 09:06:30.

ticks._note: Fills outside the auction come from the tick recorder's encrypted daily files (needs the TICKS_KEY secret). The bot waits for them until these times, then falls back to minute candles and says so in the trade note.

limit_orders._note: Owner's rule from 23 Nov 2026 (research: +4.3 bps/night for A, +4.6 bps/trade for B). Plan A: at 15:20 a limit buy 1 paisa below the last traded price; filled only if the market later trades BELOW it (so we are surely filled even at the back of the queue); if not filled by 15:25, market buy at 15:25 (best ask). Plan B buy-back: same at 09:16, market at 09:17.

plan_c._stocks_note: PRIORITY order = results of the last 12 months (net profit per gap-up trade after costs, shrunk for few trades: avg x n/(n+10)), worked out 23 Nov 2026 with plan_c_order.py. Honest test 2023-26 (order re-picked every 6 months from the past only): last-12-months order averaged +180%/yr on a fresh Rs 5 lakh vs +171% for the fixed 5-year order, and +108% vs +90% in 2026. VI is still first: best of the 13 over the last 12 months (11 trades, +1.04% each, 10 of 11 won). Owner added Waaree Energies, Premier Energies and Vishal Mega Mart (established brands).
plan_c._rerank_note: Every 6 months re-rank on the last 12 months; the bot raises a GitHub issue when this date arrives.
plan_c._live_pick_note: Live shadow bot only (added 24 Nov 2026): the auction price is not known when orders must go in, so at this time it reads each stock's INDICATIVE auction price (Upstox feed field 'iep', sent only during the pre-open) and applies the rules above with it: stocks already 2%+ up, in priority order, up to 3 and 5 x the account, each get a limit sell at the 2% price. Before 09:07 because NSE closes pre-open order entry at a random moment (09:07-09:08 before 7 Sep 2026; 09:08-09:10 since, seen 09:08:47 on 25 Nov 2026). Live sizes use the limit price (paper uses the auction price). Stocks that only reach 2% after this moment are traded by the paper bot but not live; the shadow log shows each one.
plan_c._max_position_note: Owner's 2:2:1 rule (24 Nov 2026): each stock at most 2 x the Plan C account, so the 5 x in total is spread 2x + 2x + 1x over up to 3 stocks instead of one stock taking it all. Research (plan_c_compound.py, Rs 5 lakh compounding Jan 2022 - Nov 2026, order re-picked every 6 months): Rs 51.9 lakh, 61.5% a year, deepest dip -7.5%, worst trade -2.9% of the account; the old rule Rs 57.8 lakh, 65.0% a year, but dip -13.7% and worst trade -6.7%.
plan_c._stop_note: Owner approved 25 Nov 2026 ("if you think it will be better, just add it"): disaster stop. If a shorted stock trades 5% or more above our short price after the 09:15 auction and before the 09:20 buy-back, buy it back at once (stop-loss orders are not allowed in the pre-open, so it only works from 09:15; live: an SL-M buy placed right after the fill, cancelled at 09:20). Research (plan_c_exit.py, 2022-26): on the 13 stocks it would have fired once in 5 years (Rs 5 lakh compounding: Rs 50.9 lakh vs Rs 51.0 lakh without); across all 218 stocks it cut the trades that lost 5%+ by 09:20 from 23 to 1 (worst -8.5% -> -5.1%) for about 0.01% a trade. A +3% stop cost Rs 1 lakh (fired 11 times, helped twice: gap-ups often spike and then fall back).
plan_c._preopen_note: Owner approved 25 Nov 2026: each Plan C short is also at most 10% of that stock's pre-open auction value at 09:06:30 (indicative price x indicative matched quantity, Upstox feed fields iep and ieq). A big sell in the auction drags the opening price down. On 25 Nov the whole pre-open was only Rs 9 lakh for PREMIERENE, Rs 15-16 lakh for BLUESTARCO and GODFRYPHLP and Rs 25 lakh for VBL, against 5%-of-opening-minute caps of Rs 3-12 lakh. The gap-up stock that day, POLICYBZR, had Rs 9.1 crore. Not in the 5-year backtest (no pre-open history exists); applies from 25 Nov 2026 when the recorder has the pre-open, in both bots.
plan_c._note: Plan C (owner approved 23 Nov 2026): gap-up auction short on a basket. Real-bot rule: limit sell at yesterday's last price x 1.02 (rounded up to the price step) in the 09:00-09:08 pre-open; it fills only if the auction price is at or above it, at the auction price (= the 09:15 minute's open). Gaps above 20% are ignored (corporate actions). Each morning up to 3 signals in priority order; each position <= 5% of the stock's median 09:15-minute traded value over the last 20 trading days (so our order would not move the price), <= Rs 50 lakh, <= 2 x the Plan C account (2:2:1 rule), from what is left of 5 x the Plan C account; positions under Rs 50,000 are skipped. Buy back at 09:20 at the best ask from the tick recorder (walking the depth); if the recorder missed it, the 09:20 minute's open + half a price step (at least 0.02%). Cash intraday charges. Separate from Plan B: on a VI gap-up of 2%+ both plans short VI.
